rules.title: Eliminate code duplication
Justify ESLint rule disables
Derive state from props
Avoid magic numbers and strings
Write comments as plain, natural sentences
Optimize data selection and handling
React Compiler compliance
Return early before expensive work
Ensure proper error handling
Avoid iterator-independent function calls in array methods
Track future work in a GitHub issue, not a TODO comment
Favor composition over configuration
Non-trivial new files start with a header description
Prevent memory leaks in components and plugins
Eliminate unused and redundant props
Avoid platform-specific checks within components
Do not use inline style objects
Clean up async Effects to prevent race conditions
No spread in list item's renderItem
Avoid side-effect spaghetti
Handle events in event handlers
Let components own their behavior and effects
Follow the JSDoc style guidelines and document props only where there is something to say
Use the correct loading indicator based on navigation context
Communicate with parent components without useEffect
Guard initialization logic against double-execution
Name callbacks for what they do, not the event they handle
Use shallow comparisons instead of deep comparisons
Avoid useEffect chains
Name files after what they export
Use OnyxListItemProvider hooks instead of useOnyx in renderItem
Use useSyncExternalStore for external store subscriptions
No AI-generated jargon in code or comments
Localize all user-visible copy
Import the exported prop type instead of ComponentProps
Design context-free component contracts
Pluralize with PluralForm, not ternaries on a count
Do not inline prop types on exported components
Keep state and subscriptions narrow
Localize numbers, amounts, dates and phone numbers
Commenting "Why
Control component resets via key prop
New pages must be scrollable

neverFired.title: Use TypeScript types, not propTypes or defaultProps
Collection selectors return only what the consumer uses
Use function components, not class components
